subject: NorthPeak renewal — pricing and SLA request
messages:

Subject: Renewal coming up — pricing concerns

Karthik,

Our renewal for NorthPeak (contract NP-2026-081) is coming up on Oct 15 and our usage has dropped roughly 40% vs last year. Procurement is pushing back hard on the renewal number and we have a competing offer on the table that undercuts list by about 30% plus an extended support add-on.

Before we escalate internally, can you confirm whether Redwood can offer any one-time credits or a term/price reset? Procurement needs something to take to T&E by Friday. I’ve attached our RFP summary.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Jenkins
Head of Data Platforms
NorthPeak Analytics

Claire — thank you for the context and the RFP. I’m really sorry to hear you’re in a spot here. We value NorthPeak and want to keep this partnership. I’m pulling together a concise package for Procurement and need to escalate for exec approval on concessions.

Quick ask: can you confirm the absolute latest Procurement deadline (time zone) on Friday and whether the competitor pricing is an apples-to-apples offer (includes SLA / support)? I’ll follow up with an internal note and loop in our deal owners.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Renewal coming up — pricing concerns (NorthPeak / NP-2026-081)

Team — forwarding NorthPeak’s note and RFP. Procurement needs a position by EOD Friday PT. Summary and ask below (attached: renewal_summary.xlsx, proposed_redline.docx):

Customer state:
- Usage down ~40%; renewed ARR at risk
- Threat: competitor offering ~30% lower list + premium support add-on

Requested concessions (customer asks):
1) One-time credit to bridge price gap (customer requested $20k)
2) Year-1 discount to reduce sticker (customer asked for 25% off)
3) Term reset from 24 months to 12 months (they want flexibility)
4) SLA add-on (higher uptime commitment or stronger service credit)

My recommendation (what I think might save the deal while protecting economics):
- Offer capped concessions to preserve precedent: 15% off year-1 or equivalent $ discount; one-time $10k credit; agree to 12-month term reset; enhanced SLA terms limited to a rolling 6-month service credit schedule (explain details below).
- Require a single renewal early-termination clause (if usage rebounds we limit future credits).

Why approve: churn risk is high and NorthPeak is referenceable in finance verticals. We can recover via upsell if they remain on platform.

Time sensitivity: Procurement escalation meeting Friday 14:00 PT. Need exec authorization to present a firm offer (DocuSign/T&C ready).

Deal details: deal_id=NP-2026-081, ARR renewal target = $390,000 (list).

Requested approvals:
- Vivek: high-level approval for commercial concession range and any exec signoff required
- Monica: legal signoff on proposed redline / indemnity limits
- Laura: CS/AM confirmation that this preserves account health plan

Thanks — can we get a yes/no + any alternate ask by EOD today?

—Karthik

Attachments: renewal_summary.xlsx; proposed_redline.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Renewal coming up — pricing concerns (NorthPeak / NP-2026-081)

Karthik — reviewed the summary. I’m comfortable with a limited concession package to retain the account, but we should cap precedent and protect margin. Approved parameters below contingent on Legal signoff and the customer signing DocuSign by Oct 1: 

Approved (commercial):
- Max 15% off year-1 list (not compounding)
- One-time credit: $10,000
- Term: allow 12-month reset (from Oct 15) but lock pricing for that 12-month period
- SLA: offer enhanced service credits — if monthly availability < 99.5% then 10% credit of that month’s invoice; availability < 99.0% then 25% credit (cap total credits to one month’s fees in any 12-month period)

Conditions & requirements:
- Legal must accept proposed redline (no expansion to indemnity or data residency changes)
- Customer signs the DocuSign by Oct 1 and acknowledges this is a one-time concession tied to usage profile
- No change to premium support pricing; offer a 3-month complimentary premium support trial instead of a higher discount if Legal pushes back

If Legal is good, I’ll authorize Finance to issue the one-time credit and Pricing to finalize the amended Quote.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales (EMEA & Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

1) Preserve existing indemnity and limit any new warranty language to the SLA credit schedule (no changes to data or IP clauses).
2) Add a clause that the concessions are a final one-time accommodation and will not create a pricing precedent; include a waterfall requiring AM approval for any future concession within 12 months.

I’ve uploaded the redline to the shared drive and initiated a DocuSign envelope with the amended schedule. Link below. Once signed, Legal will countersign.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jenkins <claire.jenkins@northpeak.com>, NorthPeak Procurement <procurement@northpeak.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: NorthPeak renewal — approved concession package and next steps

Claire — thank you for the quick turnaround. We value NorthPeak and want to keep you on Redwood. Following internal review, here is the concession package we can present to Procurement: 

1) Commercial: 15% off year-1 list (applied to the renewal invoice)
2) One-time credit: $10,000 applied within 30 days of signed agreement
3) Term: Reset to 12 months starting Oct 15; pricing locked for that 12-month period
4) SLA: Service credit schedule — monthly availability < 99.5% = 10% credit; < 99.0% = 25% credit. Total service credits capped at one month’s fees per 12-month period.
5) Support: complimentary 3-month trial of premium support (no permanent price change)

Conditions: Legal has redlined and will countersign. This offer is a one-time accommodation (per Legal), and requires DocuSign signature by Oct 1 for these terms to be honored. DocuSign (amended schedule): https://redwood.app/ds/NP-2026-081-docusign

Next steps:
- Procurement: review and sign DocuSign by Oct 1 to accept
- Karthik / Laura: I’ll prepare the finalized quote and PO instructions once signed

If you’d like a quick call before presenting to your leadership, I’m available tomorrow morning.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to keeping NorthPeak on the platform.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced above: renewal_summary.xlsx; proposed_redline.docx
